[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Video attachments: %c embeds clips and Z plays them[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]With a video path on the clipboard, `%c` embeds the clip under the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]new task as `![\[vid/NAME.mp4|400]]`; in Obsidian the clip sits in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the same 400 px column as screenshots, and `Z` opens a calm, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]keyboard-first player that shares the image viewer's chrome, origin[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]line, and `y`/`r` gestures. Every attachment bob copies is one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]vault sync can carry, and Bob Mac Capture previews a video as a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]video.[/#D7D7AF]
